description: First bar encounter with The Gambler. Main clue scene after the apartment intro.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: If you came here for comfort, wrong stool. If you came for answers, make the question worth the trouble.

options.text: Lucy said Blondie was last seen here.
You dealing cards or just bad news tonight?

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: She was here. Late. Sat down with the wrong company and left before the room had time to pretend it was normal.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: I did not get a name. Just a man with money on him and the kind of eyes that make everybody else finish their drinks faster. Whatever that meeting was, it went wrong quick.

options.text: That enough to make her run?

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: Scared enough to keep one eye on the door and the other on the people pretending not to watch her. That is how fear looks in a place like this.

options.text: So she knew she was already in trouble.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: Maybe. I saw something get kicked under the table after she left. Could be trash. Could be your night getting slightly less useless.

options.text: Then I will check under the table.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: Good. It is nice when somebody in this city still follows a lead while it is warm.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: Not run. Move fast, yes. The kind of fast people use when they are trying not to admit they are already late.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: Convenient is charging you for the truth. I am giving you the version that still keeps me breathing.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: That is my read. She did not come in looking for fun. She came in looking like she had run out of safer places to stand.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: Yeah. Blondie. Hard face to forget. She walked in like she wanted answers and walked out like she hated the ones she got.

options.text: Then start with what you saw.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: Only with people I do not trust yet. It keeps the conversation honest.

options.text: Honest is not the word I would use for this room.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: Exactly. That is why you came to the right place.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: Cards, lies, bad bets. Depends how much cash you are willing to lose before the answers start sounding beautiful.

options.text: I am here for Blondie, not the table.

nodes.speaker: the_gambler
nodes.text: Good. Then ask about her before the room changes its mind again.

conditionalFollowups.speaker: the_gambler
conditionalFollowups.text: I already told you the important part. Blondie was here, the meeting went bad, and she left in a hurry. If the table gives you anything, follow that next.
